steps.description: Analyze Option A: Y reacts with X in a condensation reaction to form P, which contains -COOC-, and can undergo hydrolysis, so A is correct
Analyze Option B: -COOH and -OH react, so the condensation reaction of polymer P is a condensation reaction, hence B is correct
Analyze Option C: Fats are triglycerides of higher fatty acids, so hydrolysis can produce glycerol, hence C is correct

Analyze Option D: Oxybenzene dicarboxylic acid and ethylene glycol undergo a condensation reaction to form a straight-chain structure, not a cross-linked structure like polymer P, hence D is incorrect
